content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the structure of DNA as a double helix
Identify the components of a nucleotide
Explain the base pairing rules (complementary base pairing)
Understand how the structure of DNA allows it to carry genetic information

(deoxyribonucleic acid) is the molecule that carries genetic information in all living organisms. It contains the instructions needed to build and maintain an organism. The discovery of DNA's structure in 1953 by Watson and Crick (with crucial contributions from Franklin and Wilkins) is one of the most important scientific discoveries of the 20th century.
